Subject: Voucher redemption window for Q3 cohort?

Hi Soojin,

Quick question from our Ops team — the vouchers our cohort companies received last quarter list a 90-day redemption window, but several startups on our July cohort missed the deadline due to onboarding delays. Can Alley apply those vouchers retroactively to the new cohort (we're consolidating billing under one account)? If not, is there any flexibility or pre-approved exception path we can trigger?

We have about 8 companies impacted, average expected spend ~$1.4k each if they redeem. Happy to share a list and accept any terms you need (proof of cohort membership, etc.).

Thanks — appreciate any guidance.

Hi Raquel — thanks for the note.

Short answer: our standard promo terms are 90 days for cohort vouchers, and we generally don't backdate credit issuance beyond that window because it skews usage forecasting and abuse controls. That said, we do support one-off exceptions in cases where there is clear evidence of program-level onboarding delays and a consolidated billing owner (which you called out).

To evaluate, we'll need: 1) the list of impacted startups (you mentioned 8) with company domains, 2) confirmation that they were part of Alley’s Q2 intake (screenshot or shared Doc), and 3) expected redemption amounts per company. If you can provide that, I can route an exception request to Pricing and Grants — they typically review within 48 hours.

I attached the public voucher_terms.pdf so you have the canonical language. If you want me to propose conservative guardrails (cap per company, 60-day extended window from approval, & one-time usage only), I can include that in the request.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Team — forwarding Alley’s ask (summary below). They have 8 startups that missed the 90-day voucher window due to delayed onboarding by Alley. Expected average redemption ~ $1.4k/company, total ~ $11.2k. Alley proposes consolidating billing under their account and wants us to re-enable voucher redemptions for those entities.

My thinking: approve a narrow exception with these guardrails — 1) cap at $1,500/company, 2) 60-day redemption window post-approval, 3) voucher single-use only (no stacking), 4) Alley signs a short addendum confirming cohort membership and accepting final accounting adjustments. This limits upside and operational ambiguity.

Ben — pricing approval? Vivek — any objections from an abuse/compliance perspective? Marissa — if we greenlight, can CS absorb the onboarding verification and an amended invoice flow? I attached a short proposed-exception-summary.xlsx for numbers.

Thanks,
Soojin

+1 to the approach. I think the cap and 60-day window are sensible and limit cost exposure. A couple of tweaks:

- Cap to $1,250/company (keeps total under $10k which is easier to approve at my level).
- Require Alley to sign an addendum that includes a one-time irrevocable waiver of retroactive credits beyond this batch.
- We should also require a simple attestation per company (line item on the addendum) so CS has an auditable handoff.

Marissa — if you can confirm the effort to verify 8 companies and generate the amended invoices, I’ll ok this. Vivek — if you see any fraud risk we should include an exception clause to revoke credits within 30 days if misuse is detected.

Ben

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Voucher redemption window for Q3 cohort? — exception approved (AL-3472)

Hi Raquel — good news. We can approve a one-time exception for the eight impacted startups under Alley’s account with the following terms:

1) Cap: $1,250 per startup (one-time, non-stackable credit).
2) Redemption window: 60 days from the date Alley accepts the addendum.
3) Documentation: Alley must provide the cohort roster and a signed addendum (we’ll send a template) that includes per-company attestation of cohort membership.
4) Risk clause: Redwood reserves the right to revoke the credit retrospectively within 30 days if evidence of misuse or duplicate crediting is found.

Next steps: I’ll send the addendum and a short invoice amendment template by end of day — Marissa will confirm effort and timeline for verification/invoicing. Once Alley signs, we’ll enable voucher redemption for the listed companies.

Thanks for working through this — happy to tighten the guardrails if you prefer.

Best,
